newsitem.title: SPAIN: B/Spain's Rojo calls for more prudence on EMU.
newsitem.headline: B/Spain's Rojo calls for more prudence on EMU.

text.p: Central bank governor Luis Angel Rojo called on Friday for a more prudent stance on Spain's prospects for entry into Europe's single currency after recent euphoria.
Although he qualified Wednesday's EU commission forecasts as reasonable, excessive optimism over Spain's prospects could actually hurt its cause, Rojo told an EMU seminar.
Latest IMF and EU reports have "given us satisfaction because they are based on reality, but they do not have to push us to euphoria, which is the enemy of effort and prudence," Rojo said.
Rojo added that Spain still had work to do ahead of the convergence process, with additional efforts required.
"Policy sustainability still requires additional efforts," he said.
